Fits Lelit Bianca V3!  Those extra white tabs that are included are meant to be used to make the drip tray cover flush with the drip tray.  Also, note that the silicon tabs that come factory on the machine need to be removed as well.  It did not include this in the description, but luckily I read it from someone's review, so just passing that info along.
